who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), executor of track 7b T1, int-1112
what: A launched `blaze run` built whole: `generate` called `run_with_statics` whatever the mode, so a cold hello-world walked, described and compiled everything the program reaches (2,938 ms of 9,727 ms in the codegen walk) though the launcher calls some 210 functions. The one-function form (`Build::near`, `compile_near`) existed and nothing called it.
cost: cold hello 9,727 ms against the competitor's 220 ms; codegen 188 MB and link 163 MB held warm
cause: the launcher was added on top of the whole build's output (`Built`, the linked image) instead of on the one-function form, so the whole walk stayed the producer of every launched function
class: a lazy consumer fed by an eager producer: the laziness is only at the edge and the cost is paid whole
prevention: a launched run's codegen has no entry point that walks: `Build::start` makes the entry and what start sections name, `Build::one`/`Build::one_static` the rest on first call; the refinement test holds them to the whole build byte for byte
fix: Build::start, Build::one, Build::one_static (T1 of /tmp/plan/7b-launched.md); the daemon's driver (T3) calls them. Tests: driver::tests::start (refinement with Planted::WeakByKey as control).
